title: Parking Rate Card Extract: Projected Late Fee in a Bluegate AutoPay Authorization Parking Notice
content:
**Rate card rule.** Parking rent of the in-flight draft's due date that is left unpaid stays unpaid past the grace period before the parking notice draft runs, so the parking notice amount on a Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement drafted under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization adds one projected parking late fee:

| Parking rent of the in-flight draft's due date | Late-fee percentage times the parking rent in force on that due date, rounded to the cent | Projected parking late fee |
|---|---|---|
| Left unpaid | Above the maximum late fee | The maximum late fee |
| Left unpaid | Above the flat late fee, not above the maximum | That percentage amount |
| Left unpaid | Not above the flat late fee | The flat late fee |
| None left unpaid | — | Nothing |

One late fee only is projected; no second fee is added.

**Figures by parking class.**

| Parking class | Flat late fee | Maximum late fee | Late-fee percentage of rent |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Uncovered Car Space | $20.00 | $40.00 | 20% |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | $25.00 | $50.00 | 15% |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | $30.00 | $60.00 | 15% |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | $30.00 | $60.00 | 12% |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | $35.00 | $70.00 | 12% |
| Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage | $35.00 | $75.00 | 10% |

**Hypothetical rents in force, Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage:** $300.00 gives 10% of $30.00, not above the $35.00 flat fee, so $35.00; $360.10 gives $36.01, so $36.01; $750.00 gives $75.00, not above the $75.00 maximum, so $75.00; $760.00 gives $76.00, above the maximum, so $75.00. Where no parking rent of the in-flight draft's due date is left unpaid, nothing is added. The percentage is taken of the parking rent in force as it stands, before any military discount.
